# wisp-science v1.20.0 — iOS & Android Apps

**Wisp now has native clients for iPhone, iPad and Android.** Open research projects and conversations, read replies, handle approvals, follow Runs and browse files from your phone. Both clients include a synthetic RNA-seq demo you can explore without an account or a running host. Computation stays on your Wisp host; the mobile apps do not run the Agent, Python or SSH locally.

## iPhone and iPad

- A native SwiftUI app for iOS / iPadOS 17+, with Markdown conversations, selectable question cards, message queues, Run details and file previews. Send text or up to four pictures, approve or deny a tool request, and see conversations that need your attention.
- Research calendar and project history link daily activity back to the original conversation. An offline checklist syncs with the desktop research plan after reconnecting and keeps conflicts for you to resolve.
- An experiment notebook keeps photos and device-recognized text locally. Review the text and send selected pages to a project conversation when connected.
- Previously viewed conversations and files remain readable from the bounded local cache. Actions require a fresh connection; conversation actions are not replayed after going offline.
- iPhone uses bottom tabs; iPad adds a sidebar and adjacent list/detail panes that adapt to rotation and window size.
- This GitHub release includes the Xcode project and installation instructions. Install through Xcode; the iOS app retains its independent version **0.1.0 (build 2)**. This release does not distribute a TestFlight or App Store build.

See the [iOS guide](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.20.0/apps/ios/README.md).

## Android

- A new native Kotlin / Jetpack Compose client for Android 8.0+, sharing the remote protocol and synthetic demo data with iOS.
- Browse projects, conversations and files; read native Markdown with tables and code blocks; send text, stop a turn, answer questions and approve or deny pending tools.
- Four bottom tabs cover conversations, the research calendar, a local checklist and an experiment notebook. Project history, attention indicators and saved navigation positions bring the core mobile workflow to Android.
- Android is an initial client and does not yet cover every iOS feature. Math typesetting, earlier conversation history, image upload, message queues and checklist synchronization remain follow-up work.
- Build and install from the [Android source guide](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.20.0/apps/android/README.md). This release provides the source project; a prebuilt Android APK is not included in the release assets.

## Hosts and the remote web workspace

- The remote web workspace now follows the mobile research layout, including the calendar, project history, checklist and notebook views.
- A new **headless Linux server** combines the Agent, project files, Runs and encrypted remote access in one service. Deploy from source with Docker Compose or systemd, without a desktop session or a separate relay. See the [Linux server guide](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.20.0/docs/linux-server.md).
- On a desktop host, explicitly enabling **Full Permission** for a conversation now applies to its iOS and remote turns. Other remote turns continue to request approval for mutating tools, and explicit prohibitions and research-mandate constraints still apply.

## More in this release

- **Research mandates** carry a goal, KPIs and constraints across rounds, record progress, request help when blocked and produce periodic reports. See [research mandates](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.20.0/docs/research-mandates.md).
- **Wisp Lab** lets computers sharing a relay form a group with approved members, an encrypted shared knowledge base and agent mail. See [Wisp Lab](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.20.0/docs/wisp-lab.md).
- Search across project conversation history, consult senior experts on demand and watch subagent progress in the Agents pane. Browser extension users can ask about the current page from its side panel.
- Conversation branches inherit permissions and execution environments more consistently. Transfer monitoring better handles stalls, lost copy processes and concurrent transfer kinds; finished execution plans are reconciled before a turn ends.

## Downloads

- **macOS**: signed and notarized DMGs for Apple Silicon and Intel, with in-app updates for compatible installations. Separate SwiftUI DMGs and checksums are also published.
- **Windows**: regular MSI / NSIS installers remain unsigned while release signing is disabled. Separate WinUI 3 preview installers are built by their own release workflow.
- **Linux**: deb and AppImage packages for x86_64 and aarch64.
- **Mobile**: iOS and Android source projects and build instructions, as described above.
- **Relay image**: `ghcr.io/xuzhougeng/wisp-relay:1.20.0` and `:latest` for amd64 and arm64.

Desktop assets appear as the platform workflows finish. Native clients are still being developed and have different feature coverage.

[All changes since v1.19.0](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/compare/v1.19.0...v1.20.0)

# wisp-science v1.20.0 — iOS 与 Android 客户端

**Wisp 现在补齐了 iPhone、iPad 和 Android 原生客户端。** 在手机上打开科研项目与对话、阅读回复、处理审批、跟踪 Run 和浏览文件。两个客户端都内置合成 RNA-seq 演示，无需账号或在线主机即可体验。计算仍在 Wisp 主机完成，手机不在本地运行 Agent、Python 或 SSH。

## iPhone 与 iPad

- 原生 SwiftUI 应用，支持 iOS / iPadOS 17+。提供 Markdown 对话、问题选项、消息排队、Run 详情和文件预览；可发送文字或最多四张图片、批准或拒绝工具请求，并查看待处理对话。
- 科研日历与项目研究历程可跳回原始对话。离线科研清单在恢复连接后与桌面研究计划同步，冲突保留供你选择。
- 实验记录本在设备本地保存照片和文字识别结果；校对后可将选定页面发送到项目对话。
- 已查看的对话和文件可从有容量上限的本机缓存离线阅读。操作需要当前连接的新状态，离线后不会自动重放对话操作。
- iPhone 使用底部标签；iPad 增加侧边栏与并排列表／详情，适配横竖屏和窗口宽度。
- 本次 GitHub 发布提供 Xcode 工程和安装说明，通过 Xcode 安装。iOS 保留独立版本号 **0.1.0（构建 2）**；本次不分发 TestFlight 或 App Store 构建。

详见 [iOS 使用说明](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.20.0/apps/ios/README.md)。

## Android

- 新增原生 Kotlin / Jetpack Compose 客户端，最低支持 Android 8.0，与 iOS 共用远程协议和合成演示数据。
- 浏览项目、对话与文件；原生渲染包含表格和代码块的 Markdown；发送文字、停止回合、回答问题，以及批准或拒绝工具请求。
- 对话、科研日历、离线清单和实验记录本四个底部标签，加上项目研究历程、待处理提示及导航位置保留，补齐 Android 上的核心移动工作流程。
- Android 当前为首版客户端，尚未覆盖全部 iOS 功能。数学公式排版、更早的对话历史、图片上传、消息排队和清单同步仍待后续补充。
- 按 [Android 源码说明](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.20.0/apps/android/README.md)构建并安装。本次发布提供源码工程，Release 附件暂不包含预构建 Android APK。

## 主机与远程网页

- 远程网页工作区对齐移动端科研布局，补充日历、项目研究历程、清单和记录本页面。
- 新增 **Linux 无桌面服务端**，在一个服务中提供 Agent、项目文件、Run 和加密远程接入。可通过 Docker Compose 或 systemd 从源码部署，无需桌面会话或独立中继。详见 [Linux Server 说明](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.20.0/docs/linux-server.md)。
- 在桌面主机为某条对话明确开启**完全权限**后，该对话的 iOS 和远程回合会采用此授权。其他远程回合仍对修改类工具请求审批，显式禁止和研究职责约束继续生效。

## 本版本的其他改进

- **研究职责**：跨回合保留目标、KPI 与工作约束，记录进展、遇阻求助，并定期汇报。详见[研究职责](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.20.0/docs/research-mandates.md)。
- **Wisp Lab**：共享中继的电脑可组成课题组，提供成员审批、加密共享知识库及 Agent 来信。详见 [Wisp Lab](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.20.0/docs/wisp-lab.zh-CN.md)。
- 在项目内跨对话搜索历史，按需咨询资深专家，并在 Agents 面板查看子代理进度；浏览器扩展可从侧栏就当前页面提问。
- 改进分支对话的权限与执行环境继承；传输监控更好地处理停滞、复制进程消失及不同类型的并发传输；回合结束前核对执行计划进度。

## 下载

- **macOS**：Apple Silicon 与 Intel 的签名、公证 DMG，兼容安装支持应用内更新；另提供 SwiftUI 版 DMG 和校验文件。
- **Windows**：常规 MSI / NSIS 安装包在正式签名关闭期间仍未签名；WinUI 3 预览安装包由独立发布工作流构建。
- **Linux**：x86_64 与 aarch64 的 deb、AppImage 安装包。
- **移动端**：提供上述 iOS、Android 源码工程及构建说明。
- **中继镜像**：`ghcr.io/xuzhougeng/wisp-relay:1.20.0` 与 `:latest`，支持 amd64、arm64。

各平台流水线完成后，桌面安装包会陆续出现在附件中。原生客户端仍在持续开发，各平台功能覆盖有所不同。
